hypothesis: chain_attnb.comp tests each of a lane's 32 dims against the push constants' head dims at run time, and on Xe2 ANV turns each tested term into a shared-memory round trip (45 spills at subgroup 16). With the head dims fixed as specialization constants (and uvec4 loads of a float16 cache), the same bits come several times faster, so a 16K-token prompt's first token comes much sooner and the greedy answers stay identical.
